nextgit.evidence: No live session-steering surface exists; the platform reviews the set, not the agents' sessions themselves.

dimension: N isolated workspaces from one baseline

nextgit.evidence: Artifacts forks per proposal (N=4 proven with the demo fleet agent-1..5); repo-scoped tokens with narrow scopes; per-agent repo isolation.
Fork-point change-sets computed server-side via the binding (no clones); a proposal's change-set is vs its fork point (first shared commit) and stays stable while the base moves.
Pairwise diff3 conflict map across the whole concurrent set (the /proposals summary), plus the fold preview (/merge) with per-file clean/conflict before anything lands.

dimension: N concurrent proposals as one comparable set

nextgit.evidence: The set view: all proposals as one comparable canvas (/proposals) with per-proposal stats, landing verdicts and the conflict map; auto-discovers agent-* repos.

dimension: Per-change intent record, durable across rebases

nextgit.evidence: git-notes intent plumbing (refs/notes/commits) mirrored to a notes branch so intent is durable and survives the moving base; landing-decision notes recorded after each land.

dimension: Push-style event feed driving the UI

nextgit.evidence: SSE hub (/events/stream) + KV durable feed (/events, last 50 pushes written by the queue consumer); the UI renders chips from the stream.

dimension: Land a chosen change with validation evidence

nextgit.evidence: Server-side fold-merge + push (/land) carrying evidence {repos, commit, ancestor, heads, foldHash} — mergedSha == testedSha; advisory judge (fail-closed) before landing.

dimension: Secret-class files as typed objects, masked by default

nextgit.evidence: Path-based secret-class masking law (secret:true + keys[] only, no patch, no intent anywhere), schema-only views, and the audited /reveal seam — the only route that returns a value, gated and recorded.

dimension: Agent access policies managed like developers

nextgit.evidence: Bearer-token allowlist on mutating routes (the /land 403 path) — but no developer-like agent identity or policy-management surface exists.

dimension: Typed advisory judgments over the set

nextgit.evidence: Clef judge (/judge, setId v1): typed judgments risk{label,score} / intent{verdict,overclaim} / collision with fail-closed 503 and egress masking; advisory-only.

dimension: Inline per-line review comments on a change

nextgit.evidence: No inline per-line review-comment surface exists; review is the set-level conflict map, not per-line threads.

dimension: Third-party agents hosted inside the platform

nextgit.evidence: BYO harness onboarding (bring-your-own agents push via the git-over-HTTPS protocol) — but no hosted third-party-agent marketplace.

No browser surface in the tree; the worker read API for repo browsing (GET /tree, GET /file, GET /raw/{repo}) is in flight — tracked by the existing P0 row nextgit-e14-impl-tree-and-file-read-api (referenced, not duplicated).
No issue tracker; task tracking is the loop's own bd store, not a product surface.
No CI/CD pipeline integration; validation is the platform's own fold simulation + advisory judge.
Ordered fold of the set (/merge, /land): the set lands as one ordered merge in declared order — a different model than a queue, but an ordered merge path.
No stacked-diff surface; the set view is side-by-side concurrent proposals, not a dependency stack.
